description: Development rules for AWS SAP study resource repository

rules.name: Static Site Architecture - NO Build Tools
rules.rule: CRITICAL: This is a fully static website. NO backend server, NO database, NO build process, NO Node.js/npm, NO external dependencies, NO CDNs. Use pure HTML/CSS/JavaScript only. All resources must work offline.

rules.name: Data-Driven Architecture - TWO-PLACE UPDATE REQUIREMENT
rules.rule:
CRITICAL: When adding new HTML resources, you MUST update TWO places:
1. data.js - Add to section.resources array and update counts
2. index.js - Add to searchData array (required for search functionality)

Without BOTH updates, resources won't appear in navigation or search results.

rules.name: Data-Driven Development - Pure Data Only
rules.rule:
STRICT RULES for data.js: 1. NO HTML tags in data objects - pure data only (text, numbers, objects, arrays) 2. Content must be JavaScript objects/arrays, not HTML strings 3. All HTML generation happens in render.js template functions 4. Keep data and presentation logic completely separated Example: ❌ WRONG: { title: '

AWS Lambda

' } ✅ CORRECT: { title: 'AWS Lambda' }

rules.name: Data-Driven Development - Single Template Pattern
rules.rule:
ALL HTML generation must happen in centralized template functions in render.js:
1. Use template literals to generate HTML from data.js objects
2. Automatically generate matching closing tags
3. NO manual HTML tag manipulation in other files
4. NO scattered HTML generation across multiple files

This ensures consistency and prevents unclosed tag bugs.

rules.name: W3C HTML Validation - REQUIRED
rules.rule:
MANDATORY: ALL HTML files MUST pass W3C validation before committing:
1. Visit https://validator.w3.org/
2. Upload file or paste content
3. Fix ALL errors and warnings
4. Re-validate until clean

Never skip this step. Invalid HTML causes rendering issues, accessibility problems, and SEO penalties.

rules.name: WCAG 2.1 Level AA Compliance
rules.rule:
Accessibility is MANDATORY:
1. Color contrast: Text 4.5:1, UI components 3:1
2. All images need alt attributes (decorative: alt="")
3. Semantic HTML: <header>, <nav>, <main>, <article>, <section>
4. Heading hierarchy: h1 → h2 → h3 (no skipping)
5. Keyboard navigation: All functions accessible via keyboard
6. Focus indicators: Visible focus states

Use scripts/accessibility/check_contrast_ratio.py to verify colors.

rules.name: WCAG 2.1 Accessible Color Palette
rules.rule:
ONLY use WCAG 2.1 AA verified colors from docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md:

AWS Brand:
- #232F3E (AWS Dark) - Headers, main text on light bg
- #dc7600 (AWS Orange Accessible) - Accents, large text
- ⚠️ #FF9900 (AWS Orange Original) - ONLY for large text (18pt+ or 14pt bold+)

Text:
- #374151 (Primary) - Main text, links
- #6B7280 (Secondary) - Labels, helper text

UI:
- #909296 (Border) - Borders, UI components
- #F9FAFB (Light BG) - Card backgrounds

Quiz (Accessible versions only):
- #3378be (Good), #008662 (Excellent), #c35237 (Poor), #9e6c0f (Fair)

NEVER add new colors without running scripts/accessibility/check_contrast_ratio.py first.

rules.name: Git Workflow - Immediate Push Required
rules.rule:
CRITICAL: After committing changes, ALWAYS push to remote immediately:

git add .
git commit -m "feat: description"
git push origin gh-pages  # REQUIRED - triggers GitHub Pages deployment

Never forget to push. Commits without push means:
- No backup to GitHub
- No deployment to production site
- No CI/CD pipeline execution
- Other collaborators can't see your work

rules.name: CI/CD Pipeline - Local Testing Before PR
rules.rule:
Before creating Pull Request, run critical checks locally:

# Setup (one-time)
uv venv
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install beautifulsoup4 lxml html5lib requests

# Critical checks (these BLOCK PR if failed)
python3 scripts/ci/check_data_integrity.py
python3 scripts/ci/validate_html_w3c.py --pr-mode
python3 scripts/accessibility/check_contrast_ratio.py
node -c quiz-data-extended.js data.js render.js index.js

All checks must pass before committing.

rules.name: HTML File Naming Conventions
rules.rule:
Follow these naming patterns:

Preferred: aws-[service]-[topic].html
  Examples: aws-lambda-metrics.html, aws-direct-connect-guide.html

Alternative: [service]_[topic]_infographic.html
  Examples: ecs_infographic.html, auto_scaling_infographic.html

Use lowercase with hyphens. Descriptive names that indicate content.

rules.name: JavaScript Standards - Vanilla JS Only
rules.rule:
NO frameworks or build tools:
- NO React, Vue, Angular
- NO webpack, vite, parcel
- NO npm, yarn, pnpm
- Use pure ES6+ JavaScript features
- No external dependencies

Function naming: camelCase (renderCategoryQuickNav, performSearch)
Variables: const for immutable, let only when reassignment needed

rules.name: CSS Standards - AWS Brand Colors
Automated Integration - Manual Updates Still Required
rules.rule:
IMPORTANT: integrate_new_html.py does NOT auto-update data.js and index.js.

After running the script, you MUST manually:
1. Update data.js (add to resources array, update counts)
2. Update index.js (add to searchData array)
3. Run python3 scripts/ci/check_data_integrity.py to verify

Without these manual updates, resources won't appear in navigation or search.

rules.rule:
